crossRefs.note: Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, receive in your heart and hear with your ears all my words that I speak to you.
“Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them…
But Yahweh said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I am a child;’ for you must go to whomever I send you, and you must say whatever I…
“You therefore put your belt on your waist, arise, and say to them all that I command you. Don’t be dismayed at them…
The prophet who has a dream, let him tell a dream; and he who has my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is…
“Yahweh says: ‘Stand in the court of Yahweh’s house, and speak to all the cities of Judah, which come to worship in…
“Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach to it the message that I give you.”
teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”…
They, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse, for they are a rebellious house, yet they will know that…

translations.web: You shall speak my words to them, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse; for they are most rebellious.
translations.bsb: But speak My words to them, whether they listen or refuse to listen, for they are rebellious.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt speak my words unto them, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear: for they are most rebellious.
translations.asv: And thou shalt speak my words unto them, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear; for they are most rebellious.
